scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 18 boards of nine live Deity Science (Online) games of 2026-11-05/06, each the run's events.jsonl cut at frame 0 of a turn with Rocketry known and von Braun, Kwolek, Korolev or Sagan on the host's screen within 720 points. Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch at 37664afb5 with the run's own requested genome; the on arm adds --with space-people-call-the-projects. Orders differ in 12/18 reads and the claim ('runs <project> for <person>') is journaled in 12/18 on arms and 0/18 off arms. Claims went ahead of Builders, Neighborhoods, empty queues, Observation Balloons and routine buildings, never Campus work. The six that do not fire: 222639Z t162 and 235636Z t152 are Recovery turns, which the gene leaves alone (Recovery is 10 of 266 plan-labelled turns past t150); on the others the eligible heads are Spaceport work, Research Labs, power plants or military, which it does not displace, or another nearer call found no room.
